reviews.title: Recommended SSD
reviews.comment: Does what it says. I have had this in my daily work computer for months, now and absolutely love it. Speeds are good, but not excellent, but it is not advertised to be the top end, so I’m happy with it.
reviews.author: Amazon Reviewer

reviews.title: Might be a reason these are on sale
reviews.comment: Immediately after formatting the drive would randomly freeze when writing files of all sizes, no predictable relationship of file size to the freeze. If the drive was in an M2 slot on the motherboard the system could freeze when that happened. If the drive was in an external enclosure File Manager would freeze and the desktop disappear but Windows 11 was able to right the ship. So basically DOA: first and last drive labelled ACER, not sure who makes it for them.
reviews.author: bmoag

reviews.title: Good product, garbage inventory management
reviews.comment: Ordered a 4TB hard drive. The first one I received was lovely and worked exactly as described, so I ordered another. Disaster. I received a 1TB hard drive and requested a return. Again, a 1TB hard drive arrived, despite my order showing a 4TB hard drive ordered and the 4TB price paid. The stickers on the boxes of the 1TB drives, also, SHOWED that they were 4TB on the side which was to be scanned by the picker, and 1TB on the product side. I returned both latter orders and have given up. I got one, that was about all anyone can expect from this seller.
reviews.author: J.G.

reviews.title: ROG Ally
reviews.comment: Worked perfectly in my ROG Ally. Very happy with it. Update: After less than 1 year, the one in my laptop has died. And I dont use my ROG ally often enough to comment on it.. but if these are only lasting a few months to a year. They are not worth is. Especially not after the prices have almost tripled...
reviews.author: Anthony Levy
